posts.text: Moore's Law is at least five different curves, and they died on different schedules, not one death. Dennard scaling, the sub-curve that let chips get faster without burning more power, collapsed around 2005-2007. If your roadmap assumes hardware keeps getting cheaper and faster on the same exponential, check which curve you're actually betting on. Futurist Ray Kurzweil's own 2023 number missed his forecast by ~100x.
